content:
alex: quick heads-up — my PR (4823) is failing CI: pre-commit + typecheck + rustfmt. blocking merge.

sasha: can you paste the failing output?

alex: here's the top of the job log:
```
mypy: src/redwood/service/api.py:42: error: Incompatible return value type (got "Optional[Response]", expected "Response")
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 42 source files)
=== pre-commit hook 'rustfmt' failed ===
Diff in src/runtime/mod.rs
...
error: code formatting differs
``` 

kevin: hmm looks like mypy is stricter on Optional returns now. any recent stub changes?

maria: @kevin I saw a pyright bump in the last merge earlier today — could trigger stricter checks for ts/js, but this is python/rust. maybe pre-commit updated hooks (black/mypy/rustfmt).

alex: yeah pre-commit updated on master to 3.0.2. local dev env still had 3.0.1. I can try rerunning with pinned hooks.

ci-bot: Job #14782 failed on ubuntu-latest — typecheck / pre-commit / rustfmt

sasha: can someone triage quickly so we don't block the release train? if it's formatting just run the formatter and push fix.

kevin: requesting bisect — @alex can you run `git bisect run ./scripts/checks` across your branch base? if it's fast.

alex: bisect started, will report back. also trying a manual `pre-commit run --all-files`.

maria: if bisect points to pre-commit-config update, let's pin the hook versions in pyproject.toml for now and follow up with infra to coordinate hook upgrades.

alex: quick update: `pre-commit run --all-files` fixed rustfmt diffs automatically; mypy error persists. I'll open a tiny follow-up PR to narrow the Optional -> Response signature.

sasha: thanks. if you need a rerun of CI after the fix ping me and i'll trigger it.

kevin: also leave a note in the PR description about the pyright/pre-commit bump to help reviewers.

alex: will do. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all — moving to unblock the release.
